lecture_title: Metrics, Expansion, and a First Cosmology

assets.rationale: Shows the two wave profiles used to motivate linear superposition.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: Shows the two separate oscillator equations and the nonlinear equation for their sum.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: Preserves the completed Minkowski interval in component and tensor notation.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: Shows the flat-plane metric when one coordinate is measured in centimeters and the other in meters.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: Shows the quadratic differential form together with its symmetric coefficient matrix.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Shows the general position-dependent metric after the coordinate grid is allowed to vary.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Shows the polar metric and its conversion back to a constant Cartesian metric.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: Shows the sphere sketch, angular line element, and radius-dependent metric matrix; a clean local-leg redraw follows.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: Shows the general spacetime metric at the transition from coordinate examples to intrinsic curvature.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: Shows the completed spatially flat expanding metric with one scale factor for all spatial directions.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_11.png
assets.rationale: Shows physical distance and its derivative during the derivation of the Hubble law.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_12.png
assets.rationale: Shows the null condition and the comoving light-ray equation.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_13.png
assets.rationale: Shows the cancellation of distance in the estimate that produces the Hubble time.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_14.png
assets.rationale: Shows the homogeneous galaxy distribution, enclosed sphere, and test galaxy used for Newton's shell theorem.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_15.png
assets.rationale: Shows the late-time board construction of a comoving light ray whose slope changes as the scale factor grows.
